crossRefs.note: Whoever carves out stones may be injured by them. Whoever splits wood may be endangered by it.

translations.web: Whoever carves out stones may be injured by them. Whoever splits wood may be endangered by it.
translations.bsb: The one who quarries stones may be injured by them, and he who splits logs endangers himself.
translations.kjv: Whoso removeth stones shall be hurt therewith; and he that cleaveth wood shall be endangered
translations.asv: Whoso heweth out stones shall be hurt therewith; and he that cleaveth wood is endangered thereby.
